note: 20 substantive blocks. Planning allocations are not guaranteed duration. Evidence gates, not timers, determine honest completion.

blocks.title: Initialize the repository and a recoverable autonomous workflow
acceptance_gates: Existing user files and instructions are preserved; no global or public changes occurred.
A real smoke test and repository validator run successfully and logs are saved.
Available versus unavailable models, actual hardware and network state are recorded accurately.
States are resumable, incomplete experiments are not claimed, and human release gates are visible.

blocks.title: Verify the industrial problem and current competition requirements
acceptance_gates: Every material rule and industrial claim has an opened primary source and exact scope.
Historical recycler thresholds are not described as universal/current rules.
National and international deliverables are separated, including unresolved human eligibility.
A narrower measurable problem survives the challenger or is explicitly marked conditional.

blocks.title: Find the closest prior art and narrow the contribution
acceptance_gates: Closest existing selective/reject/risk-control methods are represented, not omitted.
All cited papers are actually verified; missing full texts are marked.
Each candidate has a falsification test and a data prerequisite.
A concrete provisional choice or honest no-gap finding is recorded.

blocks.title: Retrieve small data first and decide whether the target is identifiable
acceptance_gates: Real file retrieval and license are verified or the block is explicitly blocked.
Physical sample/garment counts replace misleading pixel counts.
Threshold labels and independent positive/negative cases exist for the chosen target.
No ambiguous compositions are silently treated as exact negatives or zero impurity.

blocks.title: Preregister the experiment and validate what can be claimed
acceptance_gates: Selective risk is not confused with marginal interval coverage or batch purity.
Independent units, calibration boundaries and no-retuning policy are explicit.
Risk sample-size calculations are reproducible and impossible guarantees removed.
Primary/secondary analyses and negative-result handling are specified before final test access.

blocks.title: Implement audited data ingestion, preprocessing and leakage guards
acceptance_gates: A clean command reconstructs processed data from verified inputs.
No independent group crosses a split; leakage tests catch deliberate violations.
Units, missing labels and preprocessing state are checked rather than inferred silently.
Real smoke execution and memory measurements fit the actual machine.

blocks.title: Establish strong low-compute baselines and honest learning curves
acceptance_gates: Direct eligibility plus rejection and a classical spectral baseline are included.
All reported development metrics reproduce from stored predictions.
No final-test data was used for selection.
Trials are bounded and computationally appropriate; failures are preserved.

blocks.title: Implement uncertainty and selective decisions without false guarantees
acceptance_gates: Risk numerator/denominator, rejection and undefined cases are correct.
No marginal-coverage-to-selective-precision leap remains.
Calibration/test boundaries and small-sample caveats are enforced in code and wording.
A reference implementation or independently calculated cases validate the metrics.

blocks.title: Choose one defensible custom contribution using falsification pilots
acceptance_gates: One concrete added component is distinguishable from existing baselines.
The pilot can falsify the proposed advantage and includes the closest comparator.
Claimed human savings match what was actually simulated/measured.
The chosen scope and pending genuine student role are explicit.

blocks.title: Implement the selected method, fair review workflow and ablations
acceptance_gates: Contribution-off and strongest applicable reference comparators work.
Review/data/compute budgets are matched or differences disclosed.
All decision inputs and label access obey the protocol.
Independent code review findings are resolved or explicit blockers.

blocks.title: Freeze the protocol, code and final experiment matrix
acceptance_gates: No final labels influenced model, policy, threshold or presentation of a winner.
All primary and robustness analyses are specified and bounded.
Dry run succeeds and fault recovery preserves evidence.
Freeze manifest binds code/data/splits/configs; critical audit issues are closed.

blocks.title: Run the frozen evaluation and preserve all outcomes
acceptance_gates: Final runs obey the freeze and all attempted outcomes are preserved.
Metrics reproduce from stored predictions with independent denominators.
No false guarantee or post-hoc winner selection occurs.
Ledger states actual positive/negative/inconclusive findings and exact evidence.

blocks.title: Evaluate preregistered robustness and delimit generalization
acceptance_gates: Confirmatory and exploratory robustness analyses are clearly separated.
Synthetic perturbations are not described as a real factory test.
Unsupported inputs have safe, explicit output behavior.
Claim scope reflects failed groups, uncertain labels and coverage loss.

blocks.title: Quantify the measured value and separate it from hypothetical benefits
acceptance_gates: Measured technical outcomes and hypothetical environmental effects are distinct.
No invented mass, emissions, energy, human time or factory validation is used.
Compute requirements are actually measured where claimed.
Tradeoffs and real spectrometer/deployment needs are disclosed.

blocks.title: Build a clear, offline demonstration using the actual trained pipeline
acceptance_gates: Demo uses the actual pipeline and works without network at inference.
Spectrum/photograph roles and measurement limitations are unmistakable.
Known, ambiguous, unsupported and failure cases are represented honestly.
End-to-end testing and ledger consistency are recorded.

blocks.title: Reproduce the whole project and prepare authentic student understanding
acceptance_gates: A new environment can reproduce the documented smoke and key metric path.
No claim relies on untracked local state or undisclosed excluded results.
Student and agent work are truthfully separated; pending student work is not marked done.
No restricted/private content enters candidate public bundles.

blocks.title: Write and render the Ukrainian national research report
acceptance_gates: Ukrainian report is complete on scientific content and uses only verified results.
Current national formatting/page/size requirements are checked against rendered files.
Sources support claims, and original/AI/student contributions are not fabricated.
All pages are visually inspected; any remaining personal/release items are explicit.

blocks.title: Prepare the international English paper and synchronized supporting documents
acceptance_gates: All international template sections exist and <=20 total pages are verified.
Abstract is within the current word limit; personal/external contributions are honest.
Numbers and claims agree across languages and source ledger.
All rendered pages and references have been checked.

blocks.title: Produce the demonstration, presentation, narration package and defense kit
acceptance_gates: All demo screens and figures correspond to actual artifacts/results.
Video timing and narration status are measured and honest.
Final presentation and national/international formats are not conflated.
No publication, impersonation or fabricated student contribution occurs.

blocks.title: Validate the complete submission package and produce a truthful handoff
acceptance_gates: Every promised submission artifact has an actual file or an explicit blocker.
Current requirements and evidence consistency are checked, not presumed.
Private data/licenses and real student/AI contributions are handled correctly.
No unauthorized publish/send/submit actions occur; readiness reflects reality.
